socialEvents.description: Hello Lin, I'm Moss. I'd like us to look out for one another. Do you know where food is available now? I know roots are safe to eat, but haven't located any; the nearby fruit plants have no stock.
Hello Sol, I'm Moss. I'm looking a little west for food. Do you know any available roots or other tested safe food? I'd welcome sharing discoveries and finding a place to meet.

Hello Moss. I saw four roots at (11.21,17.58) at round 2, near your present area. Another patch at (13.16,11.29) currently shows four; I am heading there. Roots are known safe, with 14 nutrition each. The western starting roots are still empty.
Thank you, Sol. I can now see four roots at (11.21,17.58), and will collect them, eat some and keep a reserve. Your directions helped. I would like to keep sharing food locations with you.

Hello Ivo. I ate two berries and am well. The nearby berry plants now look empty; I remember another at 132.79, 12.42 and will check north for a modest supply. Have you found other safe food or noticed how fast berries replenish?
